# AmbientOS System Guide

AmbientOS is an AI-powered company orchestration platform where 8 autonomous agents run departments under human (CEO) governance. The system operates on a **propose -> approve -> execute -> audit** cycle, with a heartbeat that fires every hour (configurable in `function.json`, was 30 min before Claude Sonnet switch).


## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of the platform and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block._

### 2026-04-14
- **Governance audit trail filled in.** All 8 blocking gates (orphan, exact/fuzzy dup, task/research ceiling, social promo, campaign freeze variants) now write structured `policy-violation` entries to `governanceLog` with `details.gate` + `details.reason` — previously they only `console.log`'d, leaving the audit trail hollow (0 entries in 200 records pre-fix). Wired via existing `logEvent` helper in [`agent-runner.js`](ambientpixels/api/companyHeartbeat/agent-runner.js).
- **Deprecated escalation types auto-pruned.** `overdue_escalation` and `stale_revision_escalation` (removed from writes per Apr 11) are now pruned from the approval queue regardless of age at [`index.js:~421`](ambientpixels/api/companyHeartbeat/index.js#L421), clearing ~21 lingering entries.
- **`execution_mode: 'frozen'` documented.** The kill-switch at `index.js:514-528` has existed; the skill now documents how to invoke it. See the Governance System section.

### 2026-04-13
- **CEO revision safety net now self-completes.** When CEO rejects a social action, the safety net at `api/companyHeartbeat/index.js:292` directly spawns a new Scribe `social_copy` task with CEO feedback embedded in the description — it no longer relies on Echo re-proposing `create-social-action` on her next LLM pass. Observed failure mode before the fix: Pixel Agents LinkedIn revision stalled for 4+ days because Echo's prompt rarely re-engaged stale revised tasks. New copy tasks are tagged `['social-copy', 'auto-created', 'revision-respawn', 'social-copy-for-<parentId>']`.
- **GREEN-state cadence for Cipher / Forge / Nova.** Previously these agents only acted on RED thresholds and produced zero actions when the system was healthy (observed: 0 executes across 30 consecutive runs). Now `prompt-builders.js` injects a `cadenceSection` — if no `weekly_report` memory exists in the last 7 days (or ever), the agent's prompt gets a "⏰ WEEKLY REPORT DUE" directive requiring both a memory save AND a spec doc. Bootstrap fallback: no prior memory = overdue immediately, so dormant agents can't stay silent forever because the ≥7-day check never trips.
- **Forge YELLOW → action mapping** in `ops-intel.js:333`. When a stalled-agent YELLOW alert names Forge himself, prompt forces self-diagnosis (prompt issue? orphan guard? no work?) + comment on Nova's priority task. Peer stalls route to investigation comments. Before this, YELLOW just said "monitor closely" and Forge ignored it.
- **`publishDocument.js:293` no longer swallows errors silently.** The previously blank `catch (e) { /* non-fatal */ }` now logs to `console.log('[publishDocument] social task auto-creation failed:', e)`. If blog promo copy-task pre-creation ever fails in the future, we'll see why.

### 2026-04-12
- **Bluesky Discovery Dashboard** deployed at `/modules/company/bluesky-discovery.html`. CEO-facing UI to browse, filter, and act on Scout's autonomous thread discoveries. Features: candidate cards with score badges (color-coded high/medium/low), engagement stats (replies, likes, reposts, age), matched keyword tags, filters (All/New/Dismissed), sort (Score/Newest/Engagement), live keyword editor (saves to `systemConfig.blueskyKeywords` — no deploy needed). Added to sidebar under **Content** category (satellite dish icon). Actions per candidate: Draft Reply (creates `bluesky_reply` task for Scribe with CEO direction), Post Manually (bypasses Scribe, goes to approval queue), Dismiss (auto-pruned after 7 days, restorable).
- **Scout discovery now autonomous** — no longer requires tasks or campaigns. Runs as a built-in sensor capability every heartbeat with 2-hour cooldown. Scores threads 0-100 (recency 30pts + engagement 30pts + velocity 20pts + keyword match 20pts). Deduplicates against existing candidates AND in-progress bluesky-reply tasks (7-day lookback). Stores to `blueskyCandidates` state key (max 200, auto-prunes dismissed >7 days). Key files: `agent-runner.js` (Scout discovery handler lines ~132-238), `_utils/blueskyDiscovery.js` (shared search engine).
- **Bluesky authenticated search** — switched from public API (`public.api.bsky.app`) to authenticated AT Protocol sessions (`bsky.social/xrpc`) because public search now returns 403. Uses `BLUESKY_HANDLE` + `BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD` env vars for session creation.
- **Full skill injection — no cap.** The heartbeat reads the complete content of each skill file from `api/_data/skills.json` and injects 99-100% of each skill into the relevant agent prompts. Previously a 6KB per-skill cap was cutting the biggest skills (AmbientOS 55KB, Blindspot 63KB) down to 9% shipping. Cap removed. Each skill is now its own discrete prompt sub-section with hard visual boundaries (`═══` blocks + `📘 SKILL N/M` headers) so Gemini reads them as separated reference docs. Content agents (Nova, Scribe, Echo, Quill, Pixel) see all 6 skills (~165KB total). Ops agents (Cipher, Forge, Scout) see only `ambientos-guide` (~55KB). **Whenever you need a product fact or system mechanic, it is in the skill content — do not invent, do not hallucinate, do not reference systems that aren't there.**
- **Founder voice system** deployed (recent activity digest + corpus + doctrine). Scribe sees last 48h completed tasks + current follower counts + 10 example posts rotated per heartbeat. Hard voice rules: no em dashes, no buzzwords, lowercase casual, 5th grade reading level, authentic over polished.
- **Bluesky reply pipeline** built (Scout discovery → Scribe drafts → CEO approval). New task types: `bluesky_discovery` (Scout), `bluesky_reply` (Scribe). New approval queue kind: `bluesky_reply`. Uses AT Protocol reply payload (root/parent uri+cid).
- **Quality gate** now auto-rejects failed posts (>=70% confidence) and feeds specific issues back to Scribe. Failed posts never reach the approval queue. Scribe sees the issues in a system comment and rewrites on the next cycle.
- **Dead systems removed:** workers, planner/calibration, priority engine, action router/executors/queue (~8,300 lines deleted). All were client-side browser loops disabled by default. **Do not reference them in any prompt or action.** They do not exist.
- **New objective** `obj-founder-voice` ("Build in Public Presence") for build-in-public growth. Goal: Bluesky 24 → 200 followers in 90 days. Linked to `camp-bluesky-discovery`.
- **Bluesky credentials** live in Azure env vars (`BLUESKY_HANDLE`, `BLUESKY_APP_PASSWORD`), NOT in `socialCredentials` state key.

### 2026-04-11
- **Needs Attention** now shows convergence escalations only. Overdue and stale revision escalations removed — they were agent execution concerns, not CEO action items. Only "agent failed 5+ times on a deliverable" surfaces now.
- **Form intake tasks** now created with `status: 'todo'` (was `'open'` which agents could not process). All future inbound contact + draft reply tasks now flow normally.
- **Campaign auto-replenish** sets default due dates based on cadence (daily=1d, weekly=3d, biweekly=5d).
- **CEO revision safety net** extended to in-progress tasks. Previously only reset `done`/`review` tasks — now also clears stale `_social_action_created` flag on in-progress tasks so agents re-engage.
- **Research brief dedup** fixed. Trends radar auto-brief now dedups against done tasks within 30 days, not just active tasks. No more duplicate briefs per trend.

_Entries older than 30 days are condensed into the main skill body below. This changelog is surfaced to the top of every heartbeat injection — keep it tight._


## Quick Orientation

**Brand hierarchy:** AmbientPixels (company) -> AmbientOS (platform) -> AmbientScore (product)

**All code lives under `ambientpixels/`** — not at the repo root. This is the #1 mistake new sessions make.

### Key Directories
| Path | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `ambientpixels/api/` | Azure Functions (Node.js) — 88+ endpoints |
| `ambientpixels/api/companyHeartbeat/` | Heartbeat engine — 15 modules, ~6500 lines total |
| `ambientpixels/api/company-state/` | State storage layer (Azure Blob + local fallback) |
| `ambientpixels/modules/company/` | Dashboard UI (20+ HTML pages) |
| `ambientpixels/css/` | 36 CSS files, hand-written, theme token system |
| `ambientpixels/data/` | Static config (agents, actions, manifests) |
| `ambientpixels/docs/` | 53 documentation files |
| `ambientpixels/nova/` | Nova public pages |

### Infrastructure
- **Hosting:** Azure Static Web Apps (static) + Azure Functions (API)
- **Function App:** `ambientpixels-nova-api`, resource group `ambientpixelsV2`
- **Storage:** Azure Blob (`cardforgeblobdata` account, `company-state` container)
- **Auth:** Azure B2C CIAM
- **CI/CD:** GitHub Actions -> deploy on push to master
- **AI:** Claude Sonnet 4.6 (heartbeat agents — switchable via `HEARTBEAT_MODEL` env var, default=gemini) + Gemini 2.0 Flash (image gen, fallback) + Claude Sonnet 4.6 (Pixel Agents, Agent Forge)
- **Search:** Brave Search API (web search agents)

---


## The 8 Agents

```
Pixelpusher / Chad (CEO, Tier 1) — human founder, final authority
  |
  Nova (Prime Operator, Tier 2) — strategic orchestrator, proposes objectives/campaigns, lifecycle management
    |
    +-- Cipher (Strategic CFO, Tier 3) — financial intelligence, agent efficiency, campaign ROI, budget enforcement
    +-- Pixel (Design Director, Tier 3) — product visual ownership, performance-driven presets, proactive design gap detection
    +-- Forge (DevOps Ops Director, Tier 3) — proactive infrastructure watchdog, threshold alerting, incident learning, runbooks
    +-- Echo (Marketing CMO, Tier 3) — autonomous strategic marketing director, campaigns, experiments, proposals (NEVER writes copy)
    +-- Scout (Research Director, Tier 3) — demand-driven research, competitive tracking, cross-agent intel requests
    +-- Scribe (Content Director, Tier 3) — strategic content, builder voice, performance-driven writing, repurposing
          |
          +-- Quill (Editor, Tier 4) — brand voice, copy polish, tone
```

**Processing order per heartbeat:** nova -> cipher -> pixel -> forge -> scribe -> quill -> echo -> scout

Echo runs AFTER Scribe/Quill so peer reviews complete before social posting.

For full agent details (doctrine, escalation triggers, special behaviors, capabilities, automations), read `references/agents.md`.

---


## Architecture — 8 Systems every agent runs on

Every agent is the same machinery with a different identity + prompt. New features almost always slot into one of these 8 systems. If a feature feels like it touches 4+ systems, it's probably too big and should be split.

### 1. Identity System — *who they are*
Role, tier, doctrine, focus, personality. Source of truth: `ambientpixels/data/agents.json` + `agentConfigs` state key. Each agent has a unique `roleOverride`, `titleOverride`, contract block, doctrine paragraph.

### 2. Execution System — *how they think*
The per-heartbeat loop: build 6-layer prompt → call LLM → normalize envelope → enforce gates → apply mutations. Files: `companyHeartbeat/index.js` (orchestrator), `agent-runner.js` (per-agent runner), `gemini.js` (LLM wrapper — Claude Sonnet 4.6 default, switchable via `systemConfig.heartbeatModel`), `normalization.js` (dual-envelope parser). Processing order: nova → cipher → pixel → forge → scribe → quill → echo → scout.

### 3. Memory System — *what they remember across heartbeats*
| Memory type | Where | Cap | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| Seed memories | `agentSeedMemories` | unlimited | CEO-curated identity anchors |
| Agent memories | `agentMemories[agentId]` | 50 FIFO (see `constants.js` `MAX_MEMORIES_PER_AGENT`) with per-type TTLs | Agent's own notes across runs |
| Experiments | `agentExperiments` | 2 concurrent/agent | Tagged posts for before/after analysis |
| Weekly reports | `agentMemories[agentId]` where `type: 'weekly_report'` | — | Cadence-tracked for Cipher/Forge/Nova (7-day cadence, bootstrap-overdue on no prior entry) |
| CEO edits | derived from `governanceLog` | 10 recent | Specific corrections the CEO made |

### 4. Task Pipeline System — *their work queue*
Lifecycle: `todo → in-progress → execute → review (peer) → done`. Peer review is agent-to-agent (no self-review). CEO approval is implicit (CEO changes status on Task Board). Files: `task-mutations.js` (dispatcher for create/update/move/execute/review/comment), `agent-runner.js` (execute/review handlers).
**8 blocking gates:** orphan, exact dedup, fuzzy dedup, task ceiling (50), research ceiling (5), social promo (needs `reviewed_copy`), campaign freeze, objective (needs `objective_id` except exempt categories). Special auto-paths: social-copy tasks auto-complete + propagate `reviewed_copy` to parent; hero-image tasks auto-complete after peer review; convergence detection (5+ failed deliverables → escalation).

### 5. Intelligence System — *what they see about the business*
Each strategic agent gets a custom dashboard block in their prompt:
| Agent | Module | Dashboard contents |
|---|---|---|
| Cipher | `finance-intel.js` | Budget, agent efficiency, campaign ROI, cost trends |
| Forge | `ops-intel.js` | Heartbeat health, cost monitor, errors, governance, stalled agents |
| Scout | `research-intel.js` | Demand signals, research backlog, competitive gaps |
| Echo | `social-intel.js` | WoW analytics, campaign velocity, blog perf, social→site traffic |
| Scribe/Pixel/Quill | `performance-intel.js` | Content perf, editor feedback, design queue |

Shared context modules (`_utils/companyContextLoader.js` + `_utils/companyContextFormatters.js`) reuse these builders for non-heartbeat endpoints (standup, chat, morning report) to prevent Day-1 hallucination.

### 6. Governance System — *what they can and can't do*
- **External actions** (social posts, blog publishes, proposals) → `approvalQueue` → CEO decides.
- **Internal actions** (memories, comments, task updates, reviews, internal docs) → auto-execute.
- **Rate limits:** 3 actions/agent/cycle, 15 Gemini calls/heartbeat, 1 proposal/day/agent, 50 active tasks, 5 active research tasks, 48h campaign pause cooldown. Excess actions past the per-cycle cap are logged as `policy-violation` with `gate: 'rate_limit'` AND an auto-memory is written so the agent sees the drop next cycle.
- **Trust tiers:** Nova has lifecycle authority (pause/resume/complete campaigns auto-execute; cancel needs CEO). Echo has `propose-campaign`. Only Forge + Nova can issue `system_directive` (see `DIRECTIVE_AUTHORIZED_AGENTS` in `constants.js`).
- **Execution mode kill-switch** (`execution_mode` state key). Values: `active` (default), `observe`, `frozen`. Setting `frozen` makes the heartbeat exit immediately at [`index.js:514-528`](ambientpixels/api/companyHeartbeat/index.js#L514) with a `run-health` log entry — no agent processing, no actions, no memory writes. Set it via: `curl -X POST "$API/company-state" -H "x-company-secret: pixelpusher" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"key":"execution_mode","value":"frozen"}'`. Resume by setting back to `active`. This is the emergency stop for rogue-agent incidents.
- **Policy-violation log** — every blocking gate (orphan, exact/fuzzy dup, task/research ceiling, social promo, campaign freeze, rate limit, memory schema, memory rate cap) writes a structured `policy-violation` entry to `governanceLog` with `details.gate` + `details.reason` so the CEO dashboard can group + filter.
- **Files:** `constants.js` (thresholds, authorized lists, `OBJECTIVE_EXEMPT_CATEGORIES`), `governanceLog` state key, `actions.html` UI, `governance-report.html` (audit dashboard).

### 7. Action System — *what they can do externally*
Registered in `ambientpixels/data/company-actions.json`. Executed via `api/actionsExecute/` router after CEO approval (or immediately for internal actions). Categories:
- **Content:** `create-doc`, `submit-for-publish`, `publish-document`
- **Social:** `create-social-action` (linkedin/x/bluesky/facebook/reddit), `bluesky-reply`
- **Strategy:** `propose-objective`, `propose-campaign`, `pause-campaign`, `resume-campaign`, `complete-campaign`, `archive-objective`, `cancel-campaign`, `cancel-objective`
- **Task:** `create-task`, `update-task`, `execute-task`, `review-task`
- **Memory:** `remember`

### 8. Self-Correction System — *how the pipeline heals itself*
| Mechanism | Trigger | Action | Location |
|---|---|---|---|
| CEO revision safety net | CEO rejects action | Reopens parent + spawns fresh Scribe copy task with feedback embedded | `index.js:265-293` |
| Quality gate feedback loop | Claude Haiku flags post (≥70% conf) | Auto-reject + reset parent + inject issues into next Scribe task | `agent-runner.js` ~2500 |
| Convergence detection | 5+ failed deliverables | Escalation in "Needs Attention" panel | `agent-runner.js` ~430 |
| Stalled-agent alert | 5+ zero-action runs | YELLOW in Forge's dashboard with per-agent action mapping (self-diagnosis or peer investigation) | `ops-intel.js:79-89, 333` |
| System directives | Forge or Nova → broken peer | Target agent sees "ACT ON THIS FIRST" at top of prompt | `agent-runner.js` + `prompt-builders.js` directive block |
| Weekly cadence nudge | `weekly_report` memory >7d or missing | "⏰ WEEKLY REPORT DUE" injected into Cipher/Forge/Nova prompts | `prompt-builders.js` `cadenceSection` |

### Mental model

```
                     ┌─ Identity (who)
          PROMPT ────┼─ Memory (what I remember)
                     ├─ Intelligence (what I see)
                     ├─ Tasks (what's on my plate)
                     └─ Cadence nudges (what's overdue)
                           │
                           ▼
                        LLM CALL
                           │
                           ▼
                     ┌─ Proposals  ──→ Approval Queue ──→ CEO ──→ Actions
          OUTPUT ────┼─ TaskUpdates ──→ Task mutations (8 gates)
                     ├─ Remember   ──→ Memory system
                     └─ Observations──→ Heartbeat log
                           │
                           ▼
                   Self-correction checks (stall, convergence, revision)
```

---


## Three Pipelines (Never Mix)

### Social Pipeline
Echo briefs -> Scribe writes copy -> Quill reviews brand voice -> CEO approves -> platform post

**Promo fast-track (blog promotions):** Scribe copy tasks are pre-created at publish time and auto-approved (skip Quill). Pipeline: publish -> Scribe writes copy -> auto-approve -> Echo posts. 2 heartbeat cycles instead of 5.

Platforms: LinkedIn, X, Bluesky, Facebook (manual), Reddit (manual — CEO copies from outbox)

Key rule: **Echo NEVER writes post copy.** Echo strategizes, Scribe writes, Quill polishes.
Copy propagation: task-mutations.js propagates `reviewed_copy` to parent via `social-copy-for-` tag OR `parent_task_id` fallback.

### Blog Pipeline
Scribe drafts (kind=`marketing_post`) -> Pixel generates hero image -> Scribe submits for publish -> CEO approves -> social promo tasks + Scribe copy tasks auto-spawned together (publishDocument.js)
Blog title extraction strips "DELIVERABLE: Blog Post —" prefix if agents include it in headings.

### Wiki Pipeline
Agent creates doc (kind=`spec`/`runbook`/`release_notes`/`governance`) -> auto-publishes immediately, no approval needed.

# AmbientScore Development Skill

AmbientScore is AmbientPixels' standalone AI website conversion audit product. Users enter a URL, get an instant 0-100 score with a letter grade, see 3 teaser findings for free, and can unlock the full report ($49 single / $149 3-pack). The product lives at `/ambientscore/` and is self-contained — its own CSS, JS, and API layer.

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of AmbientScore and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

_No recent entries. CEO: add dated bullet points here as AmbientScore evolves (scoring model changes, new dimensions, pricing tweaks, report layout updates, credit pack changes, etc.)._

## Architecture Overview

### Frontend Pages

| Page | File | Purpose |
|------|------|---------|
| Landing | `ambientscore/index.html` + `js/ambientscore.js` | URL input, free scan results, upgrade CTA |
| Report | `ambientscore/report.html` + `js/report.js` | Full report viewer with paywall logic |
| Strategy | `ambientscore/strategy.html` + `js/strategy.js` | Lead capture intake form |
| Confirm | `ambientscore/confirm.html` | Slot booking confirmation |

### API Endpoints

| Endpoint | Method | Purpose |
|----------|--------|---------|
| `/api/as-analyze` | POST | Core scan — accepts `{ url }` or `{ sessionId }` (payment verification) |
| `/api/as-report` | GET | Report retrieval — `?id=<reportId>`, returns teaser or full based on unlock status |
| `/api/as-credits` | POST | Credit check (`action: "check"`) or redemption (`action: "redeem"`) |
| `/api/as-confirm` | POST | Strategy session confirmation with HMAC validation |
| `/api/formIntake` | POST | Shared intake — type `"ambientscore_strategy"` for strategy submissions |

### Library Modules (`api/_lib/ambientScore/`)

| Module | Role |
|--------|------|
| `analyzer.js` | Pipeline orchestrator — scrape → extract → classify → evaluate → score → synthesize |
| `scraper.js` | URL fetching with SSRF protection, cheerio HTML parsing |
| `dimensions.js` | 8-dimension model definition, weight profiles by site type, scoring helpers |
| `promptBuilder.js` | Gemini prompt templates for each pipeline stage |
| `scorer.js` | Deterministic scoring — decompression curve (1→0, 5→60, 10→100) |
| `reportRenderer.js` | HTML report template generation |
| `creditUtils.js` | Pack credit ledger (purchase/redeem history per email hash) |
| `stripeClient.js` | Stripe checkout creation, session verification, webhook signatures |
| `emailSender.js` | Azure Communication Services email delivery |

## The 8-Dimension Scoring Model

The scoring model is the intellectual core of the product. It lives in `dimensions.js` and drives everything from prompt construction to report rendering.

### Group A — Conversion Funnel (55% base weight)

1. **Messaging Clarity** (15%) — Headline clarity, value prop specificity, jargon avoidance, consistency
2. **CTA Strength** (15%) — Visibility, action language, value alignment, placement
3. **Funnel Friction** (15%) — Step count, cognitive load, form optimization, distractions
4. **Conversion Hierarchy** (10%) — Visual hierarchy, information flow, progressive disclosure

### Group B — Trust & Differentiation (45% base weight)

5. **Trust Signals** (15%) — Social proof quality, authority markers, risk reversal, transparency
6. **Differentiation** (10%) — Unique mechanism, competitor contrast, category ownership
7. **Audience Alignment** (10%) — Language match, pain point addressing, sophistication calibration
8. **Quick-Win Fixes** (10%) — Low-hanging fruit count, implementation ease

Each dimension has 3-4 sub-criteria. Gemini scores each sub-criterion 1-10, then the decompression curve maps LLM scores to 0-100 (because LLMs compress scores toward 5-7, a raw 5 maps to 60, not 50). Weights are dynamic — `dimensions.js` has profiles for SaaS, enterprise, ecommerce, content, media, local service, and agency site types.

### When modifying the scoring model

- Adding a dimension: update `dimensions.js` (definition + weights for ALL site-type profiles), `promptBuilder.js` (evaluation prompts for the correct group), `scorer.js` (if weight math changes), and `reportRenderer.js` (display).
- Changing weights: only touch `dimensions.js`. The scorer reads weights from there.
- Changing the decompression curve: only touch `scorer.js`. The curve parameters are there.

## Analysis Pipeline (4 Stages)

The pipeline in `analyzer.js` runs 4 Gemini calls (2 in parallel for Group A/B evaluation):

**Stage 0 — Scraping** (`scraper.js`): Fetch URL, parse HTML with cheerio, extract headings, CTAs, forms, social proof, pricing, schema.org, body text. SSRF protection blocks localhost, private IPs, and cloud metadata endpoints.

**Stage 1 — Extraction** (Gemini call #1): Parse scraped data into structured JSON — headlines, value props, CTAs, trust elements, audience signals, friction points, conversion paths.

**Stage 1.5 — Classification** (Gemini call #2): Classify site type (SaaS, enterprise, ecommerce, etc.) to select the right weight profile.

**Stage 2 — Evaluation** (2 parallel Gemini calls): Group A and Group B dimensions each get their own call. Returns 1-10 scores per sub-criterion + reasoning + findings.

**Stage 3 — Scoring & Synthesis** (`scorer.js`): Apply decompression curve, compute weighted score, generate priorities, headline/CTA rewrites, confidence level.

### Pipeline development rules

- Gemini prompts live in `promptBuilder.js` — keep prompt changes isolated there, not in `analyzer.js`.
- The analyzer orchestrates; it should not contain prompt text or scoring logic.
- Rate limiting (5 free scans/hour per IP) is enforced in `as-analyze/index.js`, not in the library.
- Report data is stored as `cc_report_<reportId>` in Azure Blob via `company-state` API.

## Monetization & Credits

### Stripe Flow

1. User clicks "Unlock" → `ambientscore.js` calls `/api/as-analyze` with just `{ url }` initially for free scan
2. For paid unlock → Stripe Checkout session created in `as-analyze/index.js` via `stripeClient.js`
3. After payment → redirect back with `sessionId` → `as-analyze` verifies payment and unlocks report
4. 3-pack purchase: 1 credit auto-redeemed for triggering report, 2 remaining

### Credit Ledger

- Storage key: `cc_credits_<emailHash>` in Azure Blob
- `creditUtils.js` manages the ledger: purchase entries, redeem entries, balance calculation
- Credits are checked/redeemed via `/api/as-credits` endpoint
- Frontend stores credit state in `sessionStorage` under `cc_pack_credits`

## CSS Conventions

- **Prefix**: `as-*` for all classes (e.g., `as-score-gauge`, `as-finding-card`, `as-hero`)
- **Self-contained**: `ambientscore.css` has no dependencies on the AmbientPixels framework
- **Design tokens**: `--as-bg`, `--as-surface`, `--as-accent` (emerald green `#10b981`), `--as-text`, `--as-muted`
- **Responsive**: Desktop-first, breakpoints at 768px and 480px
- **Print styles**: Hidden CTAs/upgrades, white background — reports are designed to be printable
- Search `ambientscore.css` before creating new classes — reuse what exists

## JavaScript Conventions

- **Pattern**: IIFE (Immediately Invoked Function Expressions) — no module bundler, no framework
- **DOM**: Vanilla `document.querySelector` / `innerHTML` — no jQuery, no React
- **Security**: All user-facing strings go through `escapeHtml()` utility
- **State**: Module-scoped variables (`currentReportId`, `currentUrl`) — no global state
- **Error handling**: User-friendly inline error messages, not console-only

## Storage Keys

| Key Pattern | Contents |
|-------------|----------|
| `cc_report_<reportId>` | Full report JSON (score, dimensions, findings, rewrites) |
| `cc_ratelimit` | IP-based rate limit tracking |
| `cc_analytics` | Scan event analytics (90-day retention, 10K cap) |
| `cc_credits_<emailHash>` | Credit purchase/redeem ledger |

These use the `company-state` API with `x-company-secret: pixelpusher` header. The `cc_` prefix is a legacy from ConversionCore — do not rename (backward compat).

## Email Integration

- Provider: Azure Communication Services (ACS)
- Sender: `DoNotReply@ambientpixels.ai`
- Template in `emailSender.js` — self-contained HTML safe for all email clients
- Triggered after report unlock — sends full report summary to purchaser's email

## Security Considerations

- **SSRF**: `scraper.js` blocks private IPs, localhost, and cloud metadata URLs before fetching
- **Rate limiting**: 5 free scans/hour per IP in `as-analyze/index.js`
- **HMAC**: Strategy confirmation uses HMAC token validation
- **Anti-spam**: Form intake has honeypot field, minimum time-to-submit (2.5s), rate limiting
- **Stripe webhooks**: Signature verification in `stripeClient.js`
- Never bypass these protections — if they're in the way during development, ask the user

## Common Development Tasks

### Adding a new dimension
1. Define in `dimensions.js`: name, description, sub-criteria, weight in ALL site-type profiles
2. Add evaluation prompt in `promptBuilder.js` (assign to Group A or B)
3. Update `reportRenderer.js` to display the new dimension
4. Verify `scorer.js` picks it up (it reads from `dimensions.js` dynamically)

### Modifying report output
- Report HTML template: `reportRenderer.js`
- Report viewer (frontend): `report.html` + `report.js`
- Report data structure: created in `analyzer.js` Stage 3

### Changing pricing
- Stripe prices are configured in `stripeClient.js` (price IDs)
- Display prices in `ambientscore.js` (landing page CTAs) and `report.js` (paywall section)
- Credit pack size in `creditUtils.js`

### Adding a new API endpoint
- Create `api/as-<name>/index.js` + `function.json`
- Add route in `staticwebapp.config.json` if needed (but be careful — that file has high blast radius)
- Follow existing patterns: `x-company-secret` header check, try/catch with 500 response, JSON body parsing

## Future: Claude Migration

There's a standing plan to switch from Gemini to Claude API for the analysis pipeline (better reasoning, more nuanced observations). Not yet active — the user said "not now." When AmbientScore analysis quality comes up, this option is worth mentioning.

# Blindspot Game — Development Skill

Use this skill when working on the Blindspot game — a standalone arena combat game at `/blindspot/`. Blindspot is fully independent from CardForge as of Mar 21, 2026 — zero shared CSS, JS, images, or audio. APIs forked but card save remains shared (product-agnostic).

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of Blindspot and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

_No recent entries. CEO: add dated bullet points here as Blindspot evolves (new mechanics, balance changes, campaign releases, PvP tuning, etc.)._

## Iteration Cycle (MANDATORY)

Every change MUST follow this cycle:

1. **Read what the user is asking** — understand the actual problem
2. **Understand from the player's perspective** — what does the player see/feel?
3. **Design the solution** — plan before coding
4. **Build it**
5. **Parse check** — `node -e "new Function(require('fs').readFileSync('file','utf8'))"`
6. **Smoke test** — `node ambientpixels/blindspot/tests/smoke-test.js`
7. **Commit + push**
8. **Ask: did this solve what the user actually wanted?**

## Current State (~120 iterations, Mar 2026)

### File Structure


### Server Files (Blindspot-Owned)
- `api/blindspotbattle/index.js` — Blindspot battle engine (forked from CardForge, Blindspot progression only)
- `api/blindspotbattle/arena-bosses.json` — 10 Blindspot bosses + 4 weekly (no CardForge bosses)
- `api/blindspotbosses/index.js` — Boss data endpoint (Blindspot bosses only)
- `api/blindspotbosses/arena-bosses.json` — Same filtered boss list
- `api/blindspotasyncbattle/index.js` — Async PvP battle engine (defender AI, full combat simulation, Elo + Sparks payout)
- `api/blindspotdefensequeue/index.js` — Global defense queue (register/withdraw/list, 1 card per user, auto-prune 7 days)
- `api/blindspotresultsinbox/index.js` — Per-user async PvP results inbox (fetch/dismiss/dismissAll/clear)
- `api/blindspotprofile/index.js` — Blindspot player profile (Elo, record, defenseCardId, progression)
- `api/cardforgesavecards/index.js` — Card save API (shared, product-agnostic)
- `staticwebapp.config.json` — `/blindspot/*` route, `/api/blindspotbattle`, `/api/blindspotbosses`, `/api/blindspotasyncbattle`, `/api/blindspotdefensequeue`, `/api/blindspotresultsinbox` rewrites

### Critical Integration Gotchas
1. **THREE boss files must stay in sync**: `api/blindspotbattle/arena-bosses.json`, `api/blindspotbosses/arena-bosses.json`, AND `blindspot/data/bosses.json` (client-side)
2. **Auth on play.html**: `updatePlayAuthUI()` checks `/.auth/me` directly and sets `sessionStorage.isAuthenticated` — needed for CardForge save pipeline
3. **`handleSaveCard()` fetch is fire-and-forget** (not awaited) — need 3s+ wait after save
4. **`isNewPlayer()` checks localStorage `blindspot-onboarded` flag + server profile** (selectedCardId, xp, wins) — survives browser clears
5. **Server reads `card.class`** not `characterClass` for ability assignment
6. **Boss data has server-side cache** (`_bossCache`) — new bosses need cold restart
7. **All battle starts send `cardData` as fallback** — prevents "Card not found" when server save was delayed
8. **Returning authenticated players auto-redirect** from index.html to play.html — `!isDemo() && !isNewPlayer(profile)` check
9. **CSS overlays**: `bs-overlay--hidden` uses `display: none !important` — never create CSS rules that set display on overlay containers
10. **localStorage is fragile**: ALL writes go through `safeLSSet()` helper (top of blindspot-flow.js) which catches QuotaExceededError, clears expendable caches, and retries. NEVER use raw `localStorage.setItem()`.
11. **Quick Build class selectors**: Template renders `bs-stat-row` and `bs-stats-budget` (NOT `qb-stat-row` / `qb-stats-budget`). JS queries must match.
12. **Card save creates NEW cards**: Blindspot pages have no `card-id` hidden input, so `handleSaveCard()` always generates a new ID. Old cards persist on server.
13. **initPlay() has top-level try/catch**: If anything crashes, loading gate is dismissed. Never let errors leave the gate stuck.
14. **Card container type stored in 3 locations**: `card.design.imageContainer` (CardForge save), `card.imageContainer` (Blindspot Forge save), `card.cardData.design.imageContainer` (server nested). Renderer checks all three.
15. **Deck view forces fullbleed**: `renderDeckManagement()` overrides `imageContainer` to `'fullbleed'` for consistent grid display.
16. **Deck card selection is in-place**: Clicking a card in deck view swaps active state via DOM manipulation (not grid re-render) to avoid image flash/reload.

### The Player Flow
```
Landing (index.html):
  New player → Fight → Stranger Intro → Stranger Fight → Win/Loss
    → Win → Boss 1 auto-beaten (localStorage: bs-highest-boss=1) → Quick Build (5-step) → Card Reveal → play.html
    → [demo] Sign-in prompt after Quick Build
  Returning auth player → auto-redirect to play.html (no landing page flash)
  New Card flow → ?newCard=true param → Quick Build → save → play.html

Play (play.html):
  Loading gate → profile + card load → dismiss gate → Lobby
  Lobby → Fight Next Boss (quick-fight) OR Campaign (browse ladder)
  Lobby → Card switcher (arrows to cycle owned cards) + New Card button
  Campaign → Pre-fight overlay (boss info + weakness) → Battle → Loot Choice → [Forge trigger if ready]
  Forge → Stats tab / Look tab (palettes + containers via Sparks) / Details tab (name, quote, avatar gallery + AI gen)
  PvP → 3 sub-tabs (unlocked after Boss 10):
    Challenge → Defense queue browser (Elo-sorted) + Gallery PvP → Async Battle
    Defense → Register/withdraw a card for others to challenge (1 per user)
    Inbox → Results (wins/losses while offline) + Revenge buttons + passive Sparks earned
```

### Combat System (Server-Side)
- **Moves:** Strike, Guard, Ability, Heal, Counter (rock-paper-scissors interactions)
- **Stat-threshold passives** (computed server-side in `computeStatThresholdPassives()`):
  - STR 60+: Heavy Hitter (guard pierce 20%) | STR 80+: Brutal (+25% crit damage)
  - AGI 60+: Quick Draw (speed priority) | AGI 80+: Elusive (15% dodge)
  - INT 60+: Focused (ability costs 1 charge + 1 less stamina) | INT 80+: Arcane Mastery (+30% ability dmg)
  - END 60+: Resilient (heal grants 10% DR) | END 80+: Unbreakable (auto-heal 5 HP/round)
  - LCK 50+: Fortune (+10% crit chance) | LCK 70+: Wild Card (crits deal 2x)
- **Boss weakness exploit**: Player deals bonus damage (10-25%) when their stat matches boss weakness
- **Move upgrades**: Buttons rename at stat thresholds (Strike → Heavy Strike, etc.)
- **Archetypes**: Berserker (STR+LCK), Tank (END+AGI), Mage (INT+AGI), Assassin (AGI+STR), Gambler (LCK+INT)
- **Move combos** (server-validated, `handleMove()` in `blindspotbattle/index.js`):
  - **Flurry**: Strike → Strike → Strike = +30% damage on 3rd strike
  - **Riposte**: Guard → Counter = forced reflect (even if opponent didn't strike), or +25% bonus on natural reflect
  - **Empowered**: Heal → Ability = +50% ability damage
  - Detected from `player.moves` array history. Returns `comboTriggered` in roundResult.
- **Combat feedback** (client-side, `bs-arena-battle-ui.js`):
  - Matchup banners: green "Strike disrupts Heal!" / red "Strike blocked by Guard!" based on `MOVE_BEATS`
  - Passive activation flashes: detect from server events, show named flash under player card
  - Combo banners: big animated name + icon when combo triggers
  - Combo hints: amber glow + "COMBO" badge on move button when 1 move away from triggering
- **HP formula** (server-side, all 3 battle engines): `60 + (END × 5) + (STR × 1)` — range ~110-175 for bosses
- **Strike damage** (server-side): `STR × 0.5 + rand(STR × 0.15)` — ~50-65% of STR per hit
- **Heal** (server-side): `END × 0.35 + rand(END × 0.08)` — ~35-43% of END per heal
- **Stamina system** (server-side, `blindspotbattle/index.js`; config in `arena-config.json`):
  - Pool: `14 + floor(END × 0.5)` — range 14-23. Auto-regen: `1 + floor(END / 10)` per round (1-2)
  - Costs: Strike 4, Guard 1, Heal 2, Counter 4, Ability 5
  - Exhaustion: below 5 stamina → 6% maxHP burn per round (accelerates endgame, doesn't reduce damage)
  - Stat hooks: AGI 60+ (Quick Draw) reduces first move cost by 1, INT 60+ reduces Ability cost by 1, LCK crit refunds 1 stamina (both sides). Discounts stack (AGI+INT = Ability costs 3).
  - Enforcement: Ability hard-blocked if stamina < cost. All other moves always available (soft HP burn penalty).
  - Boss AI: stamina-aware — reduces weight for expensive moves when low, boosts Guard below 25% stamina.
  - Client: purple stamina bar under HP bar (both sides), cost badges (⚡N) on move buttons, exhaustion pulse animation.
  - Constants: `BsConst.STAMINA_COSTS`, `BsConst.STAMINA_EXHAUSTION_THRESHOLD`
  - Tunable: all values in `arena-config.json` → `staminaConfig`
- **Cooldown system** (server-side, `blindspotbattle/index.js`; config in `arena-config.json`):
  - Strike: 0, Guard: 0, Heal: 1-round CD, Counter: 1-round CD, Ability: 2-round CD
  - Server hard-blocks moves on cooldown. Boss AI zeroes weight for moves on CD.
  - Client: conic-gradient clock overlay (`::before`) covers entire button — dark pie shrinks clockwise revealing button. Countdown number in center. Purple ready-pulse when CD clears.
  - `updateCooldownOverlays(cds)` in `bs-arena-battle-ui.js` — sets `--cd-deg` CSS var + `data-cd` attribute + `--on-cooldown` class (pointer-events: none).
  - Combo compatibility: Flurry (Strike×3) unaffected. Riposte (Guard→Counter) works (Guard no CD). Empowered (Heal→Ability) works (Heal first, Ability next round).
  - Cooldown state: `battle.cooldowns = { player: {}, opponent: {} }` — keys are move names, values are remaining rounds. Decrement-then-set ordering each round.
  - Constants: `BsConst.COOLDOWN_ROUNDS`
  - Tunable: `arena-config.json` → `cooldownConfig`
- **Stance system** (server-side, `blindspotbattle/index.js`; config in `arena-config.json`):
  - 3 stances: Aggressive (+25% dmg, take 20% more, +1 stamina cost, +15% crit), Defensive (-20% dmg, Guard 80%, Heal +30%, -1 stamina cost, burn halved), Balanced (default)
  - Switch cost: 2 stamina (Balanced free). One switch per round, before move.
  - Boss HP threshold shifts: Aggressive >60%, Defensive 30-60%, Desperate (Aggressive) <30%. Computed each round from `opponent.hp / opponent.maxHp`.
  - Server: `battle.stances = { player: 'balanced', opponent: 'balanced' }`. Whitelist validation. Switch cost deducted before move resolves (intentional — risky all-in).
  - `resolveRound` applies: dmgMult (outgoing), defMult (incoming — Aggressive ×1.2 taken), guardBlock override (Defensive 0.8), healMult (Defensive ×1.3), critBonus (Aggressive +0.15), burnMult (Defensive ×0.5).
  - Multipliers compound intentionally: both Aggressive = ×1.25 × ×1.2 = ×1.5 total damage.
  - Stamina cost adj: Aggressive +1, Defensive -1 (min 1). Applied after AGI/INT discounts.
  - Boss AI: Defensive boosts guard/heal +10, Aggressive boosts strike +10/ability +5.
  - Client: 3 circular buttons above moves (fire=red, shield=blue, nodes=amber). `_playerStance` tracked in module state, sent as `stance` in move payload. `updateBossStance(stance)` updates opponent nameplate badge + shift log entry.
  - Tutorial: speech bubble step for `#arena-stance-row` in `TUTORIAL_STEPS`.
  - Constants: `BsConst.STANCE_DEFS`
  - Tunable: `arena-config.json` → `stanceConfig`
- **Per-card battle history** (server-side, `profile.cardHistory[cardId]`):
  - Tracked: wins, losses, bossesBeaten[], bestStreak, currentStreak, nemesis, nemesisLosses{}
  - Returned in `battleResult.cardHistory` after each fight
  - Client stores in `_progress.cardHistory`, displays in lobby HUD
- **Border evolution** (6 tiers, CSS `data-border-tier` attribute):
  - plain (0 wins) → bronze (5) → silver (15) → gold (30) → platinum (50) → radiant (100, animated glow)
  - Defined in `BsConst.BORDER_TIERS`, computed in `BsCardRenderer.getCardBorderTier()`
- **Card title milestones** (9 milestones in `BsConst.CARD_TITLE_MILESTONES`):
  - Blooded (1W), Proven (10W), Veteran (25W), Champion (50W), Legend (100W)
  - Hot Streak (5 best), Unstoppable (10 best), Boss Slayer (5 bosses), Conqueror (10 bosses)
  - Auto-applied to card renderer when no cosmetic title equipped

### Async PvP System (Phase 21 — implemented Mar 24, 2026)

**Architecture:**
- 3 Azure Functions: `blindspotdefensequeue`, `blindspotasyncbattle`, `blindspotresultsinbox`
- Defense queue: global blob `blindspot/defenseQueue.json`, 1 card per user, max 500 entries, auto-prune 7 days
- Async battle: attacker plays real-time vs AI-controlled defender card. Battle IDs prefixed `bs-async-`
- Results inbox: per-user blob `blindspot/asyncResults/{userId}.json`, max 50 entries, dismiss/dismissAll/clear

**Defender AI (`generateDefenderMove`):**
- 12 class-specific weight profiles (Fighter, Enforcer, Berserker, Guardian, Caster, Scholar, Hacker, Scout, Rogue, Trickster, Medic, Pilot)
- Reactive: low HP (<30%) → +25 heal/+15 guard weight; <50% → +10 heal/+5 guard
- Pattern reading: 2x attacker strike → +20 counter/+10 guard; attacker healed last round → +15 strike/+10 ability
- Charge-aware: redistributes ability weight to strike when charges < ability cost

**Elo & Sparks:**
- Attacker K-factor: 32, Defender K-factor: 16 (halved — didn't choose the fight)
- Win: 20 base + up to 15 bonus (Elo gap / 50), Loss: 5 consolation
- Revenge: +50% Sparks bonus on win
- Defender: +2 passive Sparks per battle received (win or lose)
- Anti-farming: 2hr cooldown per defender (`lastChallengedBy` + `lastChallengedAt` on queue entry)

**Client Integration:**
- PvP screen 3 sub-tabs: Challenge, Defense, Inbox — `bs-pvp.js` manages all three via `initPvPTabs()` + `[data-pvp-tab]` attributes
- `bs-arena-api.js`: auto-routes `submitMove`/`forfeit` to async endpoint when `battleId.startsWith('bs-async-')`
- `bs-pvp.js` (`window.BsPvp`): full UI module — `renderDefenseQueue()`, `renderDefensePanel()`, `renderInboxPanel()`, `pollInboxCount()`, `showAsyncComparison()`
- `blindspot-flow.js`: `startAsyncBattle(defenderId, isRevenge)` reuses matchmaking overlay, calls `ArenaAPI.startAsyncBattle()`

**Storage (Azure Blob):**
- `blindspot/defenseQueue.json` — global queue (max 500 entries, auto-prune 7 days)
- `blindspot/asyncResults/{userId}.json` — per-user inbox (max 50)
- `blindspot/profiles/{userId}.json` — `defenseCardId` field tracks which card is on defense
- Active battles: `arena/battles/bs-async-*.json` (deleted on finalize)

**ArenaAPI methods (`bs-arena-api.js`):**
- `loadDefenseQueue()`, `registerDefense(cardId, cardData)`, `withdrawDefense()`
- `startAsyncBattle(cardId, defenderId, extra)`, `submitAsyncMove(battleId, round, move)`, `forfeitAsyncBattle(battleId)`
- `loadInbox()`, `dismissResult(resultId)`, `dismissAllResults()`, `clearReadResults()`

### Card Sharing
- `bs-card-share.js` — canvas→PNG renderer (400×560px), no external dependencies
- Renders: avatar (cover fit), name, class, rarity, stat bars, power, border tier badge, title badge, battle history line, watermark
- API: `BsCardShare.showShareModal(card)` — opens modal with preview + Download PNG + Copy to Clipboard
- "Share Card" button in lobby, wired in `bs-card-switcher.js`, shown when player has a card

skills.content: # CardForge Development Reference CardForge is a browser-based RPG card creator with 40M+ visual combinations, AI generation, deck building, and a public gallery. It's a **pure card creator** — the arena battle system was removed in April 2026 (Blindspot handles combat). It runs as a static frontend on Azure Static Web Apps with Azure Functions APIs and Azure Blob storage. ## Recent Changes _Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of CardForge and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._ ### 2026-04 - **Arena battle system removed.** CardForge is now a pure card creator. All arena endpoints, combat logic, and PvP references are gone. Blindspot handles combat as a standalone game. Do NOT reference arena features, battles, or PvP when writing about CardForge. _CEO: add more dated bullet points here as CardForge evolves (new presets, editor features, gallery changes, etc.)._ ## Quick Orientation **Frontend:** `ambientpixels/cardforge/` — ~24 JS modules, ~17 CSS files **APIs:** `ambientpixels/api/cardforge*` — 14 Azure Function endpoints (arena endpoints removed) **Storage:** Azure Blob `cardforgeblobdata` container `cardforge` **Entry point:** `cardforge/index.html` — editor page **Decks:** `cardforge/deck.html` — deck builder ## Architecture Overview ``` Browser (Static Web App) ├── index.html ──→ Card Editor (create/edit/save/publish cards) │ ├── card-forge-editor.js — core editor engine │ ├── cardforge-forge-actions.js — save/publish/delete │ ├── cardforge-quick-build.js — 5-step wizard │ ├── cardforge-ai.js — Gemini AI generation │ └── ~20 more modules... └── deck.html ──→ Deck Builder └── cardforge-deck-builder.js Azure Functions API (14 endpoints) ├── Card CRUD: load, save, delete, publish ├── Deck CRUD: load, publish, delete ├── Billing: entitlements, checkout, webhook, portal └── Sharing: cardshare, deckshare (OG meta) Azure Blob Storage (cardforgeblobdata/cardforge/) ├── user/{userId}/cards.json — personal cards ├── published-cards.json — gallery index ├── published-decks-index.json — deck gallery ├── published-decks/{shareId}.json — individual decks └── billing/entitlements/{userId}.json — subscription ``` ## # Pixel Agents & Agent Forge Development Reference

Pixel Agents is an AI agent marketplace where users deploy specialized agents for one-shot tasks. Agent Forge is the visual builder that lets users create custom agents with AI-generated portraits. Both run on Azure Static Web Apps with Azure Functions APIs.

## Recent Changes

_Changelog maintained by CEO. Agents should read this first — it reflects the most recent state of Pixel Agents and may contradict older sections below. The sync script pulls this section to the top of every injected skill block. Entries older than 30 days get condensed into the main skill body._

_No recent entries. CEO: add dated bullet points here as Pixel Agents evolves (new agents added/removed, pricing changes, Agent Forge builder updates, auto-approve tuning, etc.)._

## Quick Orientation

**Pixel Agents Frontend:** `ambientpixels/pixel-agents/` — catalog, run, analytics pages
**Agent Forge Frontend:** `ambientpixels/agent-forge/` — visual card pipeline builder
**APIs:** `ambientpixels/api/pixel-agent-*` + `agentforge-*` — 20 Azure Function endpoints
**Agent Registry:** `ambientpixels/pixel-agents/data/pixel-agents.json` + `ambientpixels/api/_data/pixel-agents.json` (MUST stay in sync)
**AI Models:** Claude Sonnet 4.6 (text analysis) + Gemini 2.5 Flash (image generation)
**Portrait Scripts:** `ambientpixels/scripts/generate-agent-portraits.js` + `generate-ambientos-portraits.js`

## Architecture Overview

```
Pixel Agents Catalog (/pixel-agents/)
├── index.html — agent card grid with source tabs + category filters + sort + trending
├── run.html — individual agent execution page (tier-aware redesign + share card button)
├── analytics.html — creator analytics + payout dashboard
├── docs.html — documentation (agent building, output types, rate limits, revenue share)
├── faq.html — FAQ with <details>/<summary> accordion
├── changelog.html — version history timeline
├── contact.html — contact form (hooks into formIntake API)
├── js/pixel-agents-ui.js — catalog logic, spotlight, carousel, filters, grid, trending
├── js/pixel-agent-run.js — agent execution, result rendering, share cards
├── js/pixel-agent-analytics.js — analytics + payout status + leaderboard + history
├── css/pixel-agents-design-system.css — design tokens + scoped resets
├── css/pixel-agents-layout.css — app shell grid + responsive + sidebar resources
├── css/pixel-agents-components.css — hero, spotlight, carousel, cards, badges, trending
├── css/pixel-agent-run.css — run page styles + share modal
├── css/pixel-agent-analytics.css — analytics + earnings + leaderboard + payout styles
├── css/pixel-agent-card.css — agent card component
├── img/ — 24 Arcane-style agent portraits (1024x1024 PNG)
└── data/pixel-agents.json — agent registry (frontend copy)

Agent Forge (/agent-forge/)
├── index.html — 3-column builder (tray, pipeline canvas, preview)
├── js/agent-forge.js — builder logic, drag-and-drop, state, portrait generator, edit mode
└── css/agent-forge.css — builder styles (fully token-migrated)

Azure Functions API (20 endpoints)
├── pixel-agent-run — Execute agent (Claude + optional Gemini/search/fetch) + creator attribution
├── pixel-agent-catalog — List agents with usage stats + 7-day trending (recentStats)
├── pixel-agent-review — AI gatekeeper (quality/uniqueness/safety scoring)
├── pixel-agent-submit — Save submission + trigger review + auto-approve (cap: 5)
├── pixel-agent-community — List approved community agents
├── pixel-agent-approve — CEO approve/reject (handles edits, cap: 5)
├── pixel-agent-remove — Delete community agent
├── pixel-agent-analytics — Creator stats + earnings + leaderboard + payout history
├── pixel-agent-checkout — Stripe checkout session
├── pixel-agent-billing-webhook — Stripe webhook handler
├── pixel-agent-entitlements — Query user billing status
├── pixel-agent-share-card — Server-side OG image generation (satori + resvg, 1200x630 PNG)
├── pixel-agent-share — HTML page with OG meta tags for social unfurling
├── pixel-agent-creator-onboard — Stripe Connect Express account creation + onboarding URL
├── pixel-agent-creator-status — Creator's Connect enrollment + payout readiness
├── pixel-agent-connect-webhook — Stripe Connect webhooks (account.updated, transfer.failed)
├── pixel-agent-payout-run — CEO manual payout trigger (dry-run or execute)
├── pixel-agent-payout-timer — Monthly auto-payout (6 AM UTC, 1st of month)
├── pixel-agent-payout-admin — CEO admin view (all creators, all payout runs, dry-run/execute)
├── agentforge-drafts — Per-user draft CRUD (blob storage)
├── agentforge-portrait — AI portrait generation (Gemini)
├── pixel-agent-run/smoke-test.js — 22 automated tests

Stripe Libraries (api/_lib/stripe/)
├── stripeClient.js — Core Stripe API client (raw axios, no SDK)
├── productCatalog.js — 8 products (PA Pro monthly/yearly, credits, CF/SF Pro)
├── entitlements.js — Per-user entitlements at billing/entitlements/{userId}.json
├── stripeConnect.js — Connect Express API (createAccount, accountLink, transfer, balance)
├── creatorProfiles.js — Creator profile CRUD via companyStorage
├── payoutCalculation.js — Snapshot delta, Pro subscriber scan, pool math, weighted distribution
└── payoutExecutor.js — Full payout execution flow (idempotency, balance check, transfers)
```

## Agent Registry (24 built-in + community agents)

Agents are defined in JSON:
```json
{
  "id": "agent-id",
  "name": "Display Name",
  "tagline": "Short description",
  "category": "tools|audit|design|...",
  "tier": "common|uncommon|rare|epic|legendary",
  "icon": "fas fa-icon-name",
  "capabilities": ["Cap 1", "Cap 2"],
  "inputType": "textarea|url",
  "inputValidation": "text|url",
  "systemPrompt": "You are...",
  "userPromptTemplate": "Do this: {{input}}",
  "outputSections": [{ "key": "score", "label": "Score", "type": "score" }],
  "generationConfig": { "temperature": 0.8, "maxOutputTokens": 1500 }
}
```

### Special Agent Flags
- `"webSearch": true` — calls Brave Search API before Claude
- `"fetchUrl": true` — fetches actual page HTML for URL inputs
- `"imageGeneration": true` — after Claude analysis, calls Gemini to generate image
- `"rateLimitCost": 2` — image agents cost 2 runs

### Output Section Types
score, verdict, text, list, tags, highlight, image, color_palette, name_list

## Agent Categories (12)
audit, content, strategy, naming, pitch, design, lifestyle, tools, career, intel, gaming, creative

## Rate Limits

| Limit | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Agent runs (anonymous) | 5/day per IP |
| Agent runs (authenticated) | 25/day per userId |
| Agent submissions | 5/day |
| Portrait generation | 10/day per user |
| Live agent cap | 5 per user |

Rate limit keys: anonymous uses IP hash (`ipHash_YYYY-MM-DD`), authenticated uses userId (`userId_YYYY-MM-DD`). Separate buckets — logging in resets allowance. CEO (`x-company-secret: pixelpusher`) bypasses all limits.

## API Execution Flow (pixel-agent-run)

```
Request → Validate agent → Extract user identity (cfAuth) → Rate limit check →
  → [if webSearch] Brave Search API →
  → [if fetchUrl] Fetch page HTML, strip to text →
  → Build prompt (template + search + site context) →
  → Call Claude API (claude-sonnet-4-6) →
  → Parse JSON response →
  → [if imageGeneration] Call Gemini via imageEngine →
  → Store run record (with userId + creatorId) → Update stats + creatorStats → Return result
```

## Auto-Approve System

When agents are submitted:
1. AI gatekeeper scores quality, uniqueness, safety (0-100 each)
2. All scores >= 70 → **auto-approved**, goes live immediately
3. Any score < 70 → forwarded to CEO approval queue
4. Any score < 40 → rejected outright

## Edit Gates (Live Agent Editing)

Click edit (pen icon) on live agents in sidebar → loads config into builder.

**Can change freely (no review):** tagline, description, icon, portrait, tier, temperature, max tokens
**Locked (disabled in edit mode):** name, category, system prompt, user prompt template, input type, output sections, powers

Cosmetic-only changes apply instantly. Name and agent ID are immutable after approval.

## Portrait Generator

Endpoint: `POST /api/agentforge-portrait`

Two modes via `mode` parameter:

### Agent Portraits (`mode: 'agent'` — default)
Style locked to Arcane League of Legends. Selectors:
- **Archetype**: Scholar, Operative, Executive, Creative, Technician, Mystic, Rebel, Guardian
- **Expression**: Confident, Intense, Friendly, Mysterious, Fierce, Calm
- **Appearance**: Masculine, Feminine, Androgynous, Non-human
- **Age**: Young (20s), Mid (30s), Mature (40s), Elder (50s+)
- **Color Accent**: None, Blue, Purple, Gold, Red, Green, Teal, Silver

### Creator Avatars (`mode: 'avatar'`)
Simple flat cartoon illustration style (distinct from agent portraits). Selectors:
- **Appearance**: Masculine, Feminine, Androgynous
- **Expression**: Confident, Friendly, Calm, Intense, Mysterious
- **Age**: Young, Mid, Mature, Elder
- **Style** (`avatarStyle`): Casual, Professional, Creative, Techy, Formal
- **Color Accent**: None, Blue, Purple, Gold, Teal, Silver

Avatar mode skips archetypes (no suits/armor), uses casual clothing by default. Output centered on face for circular crop.

All portraits uploaded to blob as WebP (community agents + avatars). Built-in agent portraits served from `/pixel-agents/img/{id}.webp`.

## Community Agent Discovery

Catalog page has three filter layers:
1. **Source tabs**: All / Built-in / Community (cyan accent)
2. **Category tabs**: All / Audit / Content / ... (purple accent)
3. **Sort dropdown**: Featured / Trending / Most Runs / Newest / Name A-Z

Community tab auto-switches to "Newest" sort. Empty state links to Agent Forge.

## Trending System

- Catalog API returns `recentStats` (7-day per-agent run counts from `pixelAgentRuns`)
- Cards show fire badge when 7-day runs >= 5
- "Trending" sort option orders by 7-day activity
- Spotlight widgets include dynamic "Trending Agents" widget (top 3 this week)

## Agent of the Day

- Deterministic daily spotlight rotation: `spotlightIndex = dayOfYear % spotlightAgents.length`
- Badge: "Agent of the Day" (replaces "Featured Prototype")
- Section label: "Daily Spotlight / Agent of the Day"
- Timer rotation still works after initial daily pick

## Shareable Result Cards

- `POST /api/pixel-agent-share-card?run=RUNID` — generates 1200x630 PNG via satori + @resvg/resvg-js
- `GET /api/pixel-agent-share?run=RUNID` — returns HTML with OG meta tags for social unfurling

```
--pa-primary-hover: #7a00e0

--pa-font-mono: Courier New, Fira Code, monospace
```

Sidebar: Explore, Agents, Forge, Vault (Soon), Activity → all pages have identical nav

Footer: Pixel Agents, Agent Forge, StoryForge, CardForge, Blindspot

## Critical Rules

### Cache busting
Azure SWA serves CSS/JS with a 7-day immutable CDN cache (`Cache-Control: max-age=604800, immutable`). Without cache-busting params, users won't see your changes for up to a week — even after a successful deploy. All `<link>` and `<script>` tags use `?v=YYYYMMDD[letter]` params. When you change any CSS or JS file, bump the version in **all three HTML pages** (play.html, index.html, gallery.html) in the same commit. This was a painful lesson — partial cache busting causes confusing inconsistencies.

Current: `?v=20260310c`

### CSS cascade
`adventure-responsive.css` loads last in the stylesheet chain. Because of CSS specificity rules, a bare selector later in the cascade beats an identical selector inside an earlier `@media` block. This means desktop-only hiding rules (like hiding the mobile bottom sheet handle) must be wrapped in `@media(min-width: 901px)` — a bare `display: none` will override the mobile `display: flex` and silently break mobile layouts.

### Design tokens
All colors come from `--sf-*` custom properties defined in `adventure-base.css :root`. Use these instead of raw hex/rgba values so the design stays consistent and themeable. Key tokens: `--sf-accent`, `--sf-bg-deep/surface/elevated`, `--sf-text/text-muted/text-dim`, `--sf-success/danger/warning/info`.

### Mobile bottom sheet
On screens narrower than 900px, the desktop sidebar becomes a fixed bottom sheet. Understanding this pattern prevents layout bugs on mobile:
- Collapsed: 110px tall showing drag handle + mini stats bar (HP/Turn/Gold)
- Handle + mini bar are injected by JS (`initBottomSheet()` in engine.js ~line 2737)
- Handle visibility is CSS-controlled: `display: flex` in `@media(max-width:900px)`, `display: none` in `@media(min-width:901px)`
- Tap or swipe expands to 70vh with all stat panels visible

### Responsive breakpoints
- **900px**: Column layout, sidebar → bottom sheet, hide immersive button
- **768px**: Wizard stats stack vertically
- **600px**: 2-col genre grid, hide wizard step labels, smaller text
- **480px**: Hide logo text, compact header, wrap audio controls, hide choice keys

### High blast-radius files
These files are large and interconnected — read them fully before editing, and keep changes minimal and focused:
- `adventure-engine.js` — orchestrates everything (2,787 lines)
- `adventure-play.css` — all play screen styling (2,757 lines)
- `adventure-responsive.css` — all mobile breakpoints (cascade-sensitive)
- `data/genres.json` — affects AI prompts, game balance, character options

## Common Tasks

### Add a new genre
1. Add entry to `data/genres.json` with all required fields (use fantasy as template)
2. Add genre-specific CSS in `adventure-play.css` (`.adv-app[data-genre="newgenre"] .adv-scene__image-wrap`)
3. Add genre particle variant in `adventure-particles.css`
4. Add 3-4 ambient music tracks to `audio/ambient/newgenre-*.mp3`
5. Add genre card image to `images/genre-newgenre.webp`
6. Bump `?v=` in all three HTML files

### Modify play screen layout
1. Read `adventure-play.css` for the section you're changing
2. Check `adventure-responsive.css` for all breakpoints that affect it
3. Test at 390px (iPhone 13), 768px (tablet), and 1200px+ (desktop)
4. Bump `?v=` in all three HTML files

### Modify game mechanics
- Stats/combat/inventory: `adventure-rpg.js`
- Turn flow/choices/scene: `adventure-engine.js`
- AI prompts: `adventure-ai.js` + genre prompts in `data/genres.json`
